choices.why: This sofa has the low, clean-lined beige fabric and tapered dark legs the user asked for, and at 229 cm it fills the long right wall without crowding it.
A flatwoven seagrass rug in warm natural fiber lightens the dark floor and is large enough to anchor the sofa front and the coffee table.
This large, low, round table in mid-tone wood with simple splayed legs is quintessentially Japandi and matches the serene look.
This tall rice-paper floor lamp is exactly the lantern-style paper lamp requested and gives soft light in the corner by the sofa.
A tall areca palm is the large plant that fills the corner by the balcony door with airy greenery, while the catalog pots are too small for the effect.

answer.why: Beige fabric, seagrass, warm wood and white paper make a calm, neutral palette that softens the dark floor and white walls, and the single tall palm adds a natural vertical accent by the glass, staying minimal as requested.
